title: The Pinata Free-For-All! III
description: The Pinata Free-For-All! III — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the Pinata and Slay 6 Champion Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy the Pinata and Slay 6 Champion Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

The fans are really starting to talk about you, Dungeon Runner. Your the only one using weapons, skills, and potions to defeat the pinata and the other gladiators right? I knew it was you! If you really want to get them talking you should try to take out some of the Champion Gladiators.

When you are ready, head down to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Take out the pinata and 6 Champion Gladiators. When you are done return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

I can't believe you are still alive! Good for you. Let me know if you want to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata
  • Slay Champion Gladiators

Client level range: 85–100
